author: harness:codex

patch.value: Warn when custom schema fields collide with MCP transport or tool-specific inputs

Surface a schema-author diagnostic when a runtime custom field such as cwd, path, options, or allowMissingParent cannot be projected as a top-level MCP input because a canonical transport/tool property owns that name. Preserve the collision-safe runtime behavior delivered in pm-xwah; report the conflict during schema add-field/profile/extension validation instead of emitting noisy MCP stdio runtime warnings.

Schema and extension authors receive a deterministic collision diagnostic naming the custom field and canonical MCP property owner; Nested options remain available for the custom value and no transport routing semantics change
